messages:
Sarah (oncall): quick handoff from my shift — short bullets below, please skim and ack if you’re taking anything.

Sarah (oncall): Current incidents: 
1) Hosted API regen latency spike in eu-west1 — p50/ p95 jumped ~2x after 03:10 UTC. Affected a portion of user traffic on model-v2.
2) Embed worker kvcache evictions causing increased cold reads and cost on embed-ingest pipeline (workers e-3).
3) Canary deploy of autoscaler tweak rolled back automatically on one pod group (saw OOMs).

Sarah (oncall): What I did / mitigations applied: 
- For regen latency: scaled up dedicated pool in eu-west1 by +2 nodes, routed 20% traffic to fallback model-v1, set request timeout override to 4s while we triage.
- For kvcache evictions: increased redis maxmemory-policy to volatile-lru temporarily, bumped eviction threshold from 75% -> 85% to reduce churn.
- For canary rollback: reverted the autoscaler config in cluster/overrides and pinned the deployment back to previous image.

Sarah (oncall): Quick checks / commands I ran (for context):
```
# check pods in eu-west1
kubectl get pods -n hosted-eu -l app=regen --sort-by=.status.startTime
# check redis evictions
redis-cli -h r-eu-01 INFO stats | egrep "evicted_keys|used_memory_human"
```

Sarah (oncall): Observations: latency drop started ~30s after increased client concurrency from a set of customers; regen CPU per-token rose on two GPU hosts (possible kernel path regression). Redis evictions spiked when embed-ingest backlog hit ~6k tasks.

Sarah (oncall): Next steps / asks: 
- Chen: can you take point on the regen latency root cause? I left a heapdump + perf trace in s3://redwood-shifts/4056789123/ (files: trace.pb, heap.tgz). If you can triage and escalate to runtime team if kernel mismatch, please.
- Mike: can you follow up on embed kvcache tuning and watch cost alerts? I pushed a temporary config to k8s configmap embed-cache-tmp. If we need a persistent fix, open a ticket and tag infra-sql/infra-cache.
- Julia: please own the post-handoff writeup / incidents ticket with timelines (I added ephemeral notes in the runbook).

Chen: on it — grabbing the perf trace now, will run the micro-repro workload and check kernel versions.

Mike: ack, watching billing and redis metrics. If evictions persist after 1 hour I’ll scale redis shards horizontally.

OpsBot: incident created: INC-2026-1482 (regen latency, priority P2). Bridge link: https://zoom.us/j/0000000000 (auto).

Julia: ack, will draft the incident timeline and capture mitigations + owner list.

Sarah (oncall): Additional notes: avoid any non-urgent deploys to eu-west1 until regen rc is stable. I flagged the bake pipeline to block. Also, I left two PR pings: 
- PR #3185 (autoscaler: tolerate-oom-fallback) — @Chen please review, I left comments on the mem thresholds.
- PR #3192 (embed-cache: async-save fix) — @Mike please take a look when you have a minute.

Chen: noted on PR #3185, will try to review in the next hour. If I find a kernel incompat I'll loop in @runtime-team.

Mike: skimmed #3192, left one comment about metrics tags. Will finish review after I confirm redis stability.

Sarah (oncall): Handoff summary / end state I expect by next shift: 
- Regen latency regressed to baseline (p95 < previous 1.8s) or an actionable RCA with owner assigned.
- Embed evictions under control (eviction rate normalized, cost steady).
- Autoscaler remains pinned until we've validated memory profile changes.

Sarah (oncall): If anyone takes ownership of a bullet, reply with the bullet number and :thumbsup:. Otherwise I’ll assume Chen/Mike/Julia as called out.

Chen: 1) taking. :thumbsup:
Mike: 2) taking. :thumbsup:
Julia: 3) taking the writeup/coord. :thumbsup:

Sarah (oncall): Thanks — I’ll stay reachable for 20 more minutes for any quick context handoffs, then I’m off. Good night team.

Julia: will ping after I finish the timeline and link the incident ticket.

Chen: quick note — if we need to repro, run the synthetic load with concurrency 48 on the microbench harness (repo: infra/synth). I put the command in the runbook.

Mike: FYI I've muted non-critical alerts for embed-cost for 30m to reduce noise while we triage.

OpsBot: shift handoff recorded by OpsBot at 4056790798.

Sarah (oncall): last: leaving the pager to Chen for regen and Mike for embed. Julia will own postmortem collate. Thanks.

Julia: ack, closing the loop here. I’ll post the incident summary in #incidents once drafted. :white_check_mark:
